uncited: This family serves as the foundational mechanism for [Classification and transfer functions](38-classification-and-transfer-functions.md), distinguishing itself from [Style Transfer Function (1D)](777-style-transfer-function-1d.md) by focusing on the binary/continuous decision boundary rather than stylistic mapping, and from [Boundary-Enhanced Opacity](795-boundary-enhanced-opacity.md) by operating on scalar values rather than gradient-derived features.
The core mechanism involves evaluating a scalar input value $v$ (e.g., voxel intensity) against a defined criterion to produce an output value $y$ (e.g., opacity).
**Spectral Impact**: The shape of the classification function directly affects the frequency content of the rendered image.
